allCandidates.push(...candidates);\n  }\n\n  // Sort all candidates across tiers by optimal moves (ascending) then by diversity (descending)\n  allCandidates.sort((a, b) => {\n    if (a.optimalMoves ${selected[0]?.diversity}-${selected[selected.length-1]?.diversity})`);\n\n  return selected.map(c => c.level);\n}\n\n/**\n * Write individual level files to levels/<game>/ and update
